notes.title: Hitting pause on a lil' exploit
notes.content:
[b]Mastermine[/b] has been updated once again.

In previous versions, players could peek through the blurry pause menu to gain an advantage by solving the puzzle while the game was paused. This has been patched, and the leaderboard has been adjusted to remove suspiciously fast times.

Here's the full changelog, with a couple of bonus changes:

[list]
[*] The Mastermine Wrapped event has finished
[*] Fixed a shader bug causing false flags to "glow" at the end of games
[*] Adjusted wording to "Click" instead of "Tap" on PC
[*] Fixed an infuriating 1 pixel gap visible on PC menu buttons
[*] Prevented peeking through the pause menu
[/list]

notes.title: Daily Leaderboards
notes.content:
Mastermine now has Daily Leaderboards! Every 24 hours, see who's best on all cube sizes, and get a good chance at finishing high on the boards.

They'll reset each day at midnight UTC.

Other changes and fixes included in this patch are detailed in the [url=https://mastermine.app/changelog]changelog[/url].

Happy Solving!

notes.title: Mastermine v1.12.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39689211/2417f2cf19692504d7e79fb7deca368bc95a00af.png[/img]

[i]Mastermine v1.12.1 includes a bunch of improvements and quality of life fixes[/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that left some players stuck in Campaign
[*] Added F2 as a shortcut for Retry, just like classic minesweeper
[*] Dramatically reduced CPU usage (100% -> 25% in testing)
[*] Fixed accidentally revealing cubes while trying to activate powerups
[*] The game will now catch corrupted Campaign saves and automatically restart the Campaign level
[*] Reduced the chance of unexpected behaviour in-game
[*] Adjusted audio mixing & volume ducking
[*] Fixed inconsistent scrolling in some areas
[/list]

Happy solving!

notes.title: Mastermine v1.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39689211/5f7d90860d01cb5e367bca00ce4543d4b27503df.png[/img]

[i]Mastermine v1.12 adds some long-requested features, alongside quality of life fixes[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]You can now disable seeing through the centre of the cube, blocking out its gaps[/b]
[*] You can now bind "Drag/Rotate cube" to any control, to avoid accidental clicks
[*] You can now bind Mouse 4 and Mouse 5 (the forward/backward buttons) to any control
[*] You can now use the "A" and "D" keys to roll the cube, like two-finger rotate on mobile
[/list]

Happy solving!
